Abbosbek Fayzullaev.note: Fayzullaev's World Cup has already included a goal against Colombia. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Abbosbek Fayzullaev.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Abdukodir Khusanov.note: Khusanov is in the quiet-work part of Uzbekistan's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Abdukodir Khusanov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Abdulla Abdullaev.note: Abdullaev gives Uzbekistan defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Abdulla Abdullaev.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Abduvohid Nematov.note: Nematov gives Uzbekistan a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Abduvohid Nematov.noteZh: 他在Uzbekistan首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Akmal Mozgovoy.note: Mozgovoy has supplied one of Uzbekistan's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Akmal Mozgovoy.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Uzbekistan创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.note: Ulmasaliyev gives Uzbekistan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Azizbek Amonov.note: Amonov is midfield insurance for Uzbekistan. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Azizbek Amonov.noteZh: 他给Uzbekistan一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Azizjon Ganiev.note: Ganiev gives Uzbekistan a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Azizjon Ganiev.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Behruzjon Karimov.note: Karimov gives Uzbekistan another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Behruzjon Karimov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Botirali Ergashev.note: Ergashev sits behind the starter for Uzbekistan, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Botirali Ergashev.noteZh: 他给Uzbekistan保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Dostonbek Khamdamov.note: Khamdamov is attacking depth for Uzbekistan. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Dostonbek Khamdamov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Eldor Shomurodov.note: Shomurodov's World Cup has already included a goal against DR Congo. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Eldor Shomurodov.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Farrukh Sayfiev.note: Sayfiyev gives Uzbekistan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Farrukh Sayfiev.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Igor Sergeev.note: Sergeev gives Uzbekistan a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Igor Sergeev.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Jakhongir Urozov.note: Urozov is defensive cover for Uzbekistan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Jakhongir Urozov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Jamshid Iskanderov.note: Iskanderov is midfield insurance for Uzbekistan. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Jamshid Iskanderov.noteZh: 他给Uzbekistan一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Khojiakbar Alijonov.note: Alijonov gives Uzbekistan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Khojiakbar Alijonov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Odiljon Xamrobekov.note: Hamrobekov gives Uzbekistan midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Odiljon Xamrobekov.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Uzbekistan来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Oston Urunov.note: Urunov is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Uzbekistan, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Oston Urunov.noteZh: 他给Uzbekistan提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Otabek Shukurov.note: Shukurov has been one of Uzbekistan's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Otabek Shukurov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Ruslanbek Jiyanov.note: Jiyanov is the forward Uzbekistan can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Ruslanbek Jiyanov.noteZh: 他给Uzbekistan替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Rustamjon Ashurmatov.note: Ashurmatov has been part of Uzbekistan's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.noteZh: 他在Uzbekistan体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Sherzod Esanov.note: Esanov gives Uzbekistan midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Sherzod Esanov.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Uzbekistan来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Sherzod Nasrullaev.note: Nasrullaev has been part of Uzbekistan's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Sherzod Nasrullaev.noteZh: 他给Uzbekistan后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Umarbek Eshmurodov.note: Eshmurodov is the kind of defender Uzbekistan can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Umarbek Eshmurodov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Utkir Yusupov.note: Yusupov is Uzbekistan's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Utkir Yusupov.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。
